prompt: node http.request path illegal characters which rejected
answer:
`http.request()` rejects path characters outside the range `U+0021`–`U+00FF`:

- Control characters `U+0000`–`U+0020`, including:
  - space (`\x20`)
  - carriage return (`\r`)
  - line feed (`\n`)
  - null (`\0`)
- Characters above `U+00FF`, including non-Latin-1/two-byte Unicode characters.

These invalid paths produce `ERR_UNESCAPED_CHARACTERS`. Reassigning `req.path` with `\r`, `\n`, `\r\n`, or `\0` is also reported to throw that error. (Search results: [Node.js PR #62030](https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/62030), [Node.js commit b961d9f](https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/b961d9fd83), [Undici validation](https://fossies.org/diffs/node/v25.9.0_vs_v26.0.0/deps/undici/src/lib/core/request.js-diff.html))
